name: Executable Gap Desk
description: A gate for BSC tokenized US stocks (Ondo, xStocks, bStocks). It quotes every venue of a stock at a real size and says whether the displayed discount is executable: GO, CAUTION or BLOCK with reasons. Paid endpoints over x402 v2 settle through Binance B402 on BSC: 0.01 U for the gate JSON of a stock, 0.02 U for the best route at a USD size. Free index at /x402.
